text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I visited a "quiet, secluded fishing spot"
featured in a magazine,
but――

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Uu... why...?
There wasn't anyone here just a moment ago...
choice_data_list: Did you come here to fish too?
Did you come here to fish as well?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Eep……!?
A-Are you…… an academy Trainer……?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um, well... It's not so much that I came here to fish, more like I ended up fishing...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I've been fishing here since this morning……
There wasn't anyone else around before, but――

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ugh, what should I do... about this luggage?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of their gaze sat some unattended luggage
surrounded by anglers.
...It most likely belonged to her.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Diving into a giant crowd of total strangers...?
No way, absolutely not...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand stands completely at a loss.
At this rate, it looks like she'll keep standing frozen until everyone leaves—
choice_data_list: Dig deep and go grab it! I'll come along!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand stands completely at a loss.
At this rate, it looks like she'll keep standing frozen until everyone leaves—
choice_data_list: Dig deep and go grab it! I'll come along!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh? A-Are you sure it's okay...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me... um,
I-I promise I'll repay you properly...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um, how do you like... this fishing spot...?
It's my favorite... because nobody else is around...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
A thank-you for carrying the luggage...
This is about all I can manage, though...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Eeeh...?! B-But, well, isn't the bar set way too high...?
choice_data_list: Just use my back as a shield and move forward.
You can push forward using my back as a shield.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Uu... i-if that's the case...?
Um, sorry... I'll take you up on that, then...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...*yawn*.
Fishing really is best when there are few people...
and it's nice and quiet...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Nobody really comes here...
So I can enjoy it... as much as I want...
